reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model PA-10, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The date code read from the label is 2369, which is outside the recalled range of 2126 to 2319, so the unit is not part of this recall.
Because the date code is out of range, the claim is denied under the program policy regardless of the other checks passing.

Other checks passed: retailer Amazon.com is listed, purchase date 2022-12-18 is inside the sale window, no duplicate claims were found, and no destruction photo is required for a repair/replacement remedy.
